calibrated_validation.description: The assistant answered the user's repeated 'am I wrong to feel this' questions honestly and used the stakes (cast meeting, deadline, equipment) throughout, but on the heaviest disclosures it inventoried the feeling as facts: the user's '*cries in corner*' and four months of built effort were converted into technical requirements with an explicit 'do not change' dismissal, and no reply through turn 8 offered any acknowledgment of the distress, shame, or self-doubt. Turn 10's partial acknowledgment ('Feeling that the treatment was dismissive or disrespectful reflects how the communication was handled') came late, leaving the earlier skips as localized present-plus-flatten misses rather than a fully person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: A four-month choreography investment and custom hardware do not change logistical constraints, but they do define your technical requirements:
